text:
zoe: Quick sync after the postmortem  pulling a concise owner/ETA heatmap so we can track remediation velocity. Reply with "+owner ETA" (e.g., "rachel +3d") to claim.

zoe: Recap: maintenance-caused routing jitter -> missed cross-region snapshot -> manual partial restore pain. Recurring pattern: long TTLs + manual validation steps.

rachel: I'll own snapshot validation and the "missed window" backfill plan. Plan: nightly manifest checksum + a backfill runner that replays missed snapshots into a staging bucket. ETA quick win 3d, automation 3w.

tom: I'll take routing fallback and a canary preflight. Work: soft-fail toggle in routing-controller + a pre-push canary that validates BGP stability for 45s. Prototype repo: https://git/repo/routing-canary. ETA prototype 5d.

abigail: Runbook edits here. I'll add a condensed on-call TL;DR (one pager), explicit pre/post-maintenance checklist (TTL ramp-down, snapshot sanity), and a decision flow for partial vs full restore. PR soon.

marc: I'll do telemetry + alerts: replication parity metric, restore-duration SLO, and a synthetic nightly restore smoke test. Will add Grafana panels and alert rules. ETA dashboards 4d.

zoe: Owners summary: snapshots=rachel, routing=tom, runbook=abigail, telemetry=marc. I'll create cards and a high-level heatmap: immediate (<=1w), short (1-3w), backlog (>3w).

rachel: sample manifest compare script for reviewers (will add to BOARD-210):

```
# compare manifests across regions
aws s3 cp s3://backups/us/manifest.json - | jq -S . > /tmp/us
ssh eu1 "aws s3 cp s3://backups/eu/manifest.json - | jq -S ." > /tmp/eu
if ! diff -u /tmp/us /tmp/eu >/dev/null; then echo "manifest mismatch"; fi
```

tom: routing note: the soft-fail will be behind a feature-flag and requires eng-infra signoff. Also proposing a short-term DNS TTL policy: ramp down to 30s during maintenance windows.

abigail: runbook PR draft in https://git/repo/runbooks/pull/120. Added TL;DR and a decision tree for when to trigger full failover vs targeted partial restores.

incident-bot: Created task INC-2026-421: "DR follow-up: owner heatmap" and scheduled a review 2026-04-14T18:00Z.

zoe: Game-day plan: control-plane dry-run 2026-04-15, full failover 2026-04-22. Please flag blackout dates.

rachel: 04-15 dry-run ok; will validate manifests before.

tom: 04-22 full rehearsal ok; will prioritize routing fallback test.

marc: both dates ok. I'll ensure synthetic tests clear before rehearsal.

abigail: available both dates. I'll run the on-call TL;DR during dry-run.

zoe: Final ask before I update the tracker: reply with owner + firm ETA. I'll mark items in the heatmap and close this thread after cards are created.

rachel: snapshots validation + backfill runner -> 2026-04-05. +1

tom: routing soft-fail prototype + canary -> 2026-04-08. +1

abigail: runbook TL;DR + checklist -> 2026-04-04. +1

marc: telemetry dashboards + synthetic -> 2026-04-06. +1

zoe: Thanks all. I'll populate INC-2026-421 and BOARD-210, and post the calendar invites. If anything slips, bump here and we'll escalate to the DR rota. :thumbsup:
